preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is between 1 and 20,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(3 <= n <= 2 * 10**5 for n in [int(input().split()[0]) for _ in range(t)])
preconditions.description: For each test case, the number of bricks n is between 3 and 200,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= 10**9 for n, *weights in [list(map(int, input().split())) for _ in range(t)] for a_i in weights)
preconditions.description: For each test case, each brick weight a_i is between 1 and 10^9 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: sum(n for n, *weights in [list(map(int, input().split())) for _ in range(t)]) <= 2 * 10**5
preconditions.description: The sum of n over all test cases does not exceed 200,000.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(result, int) for result in results)
all(0 <= result <= 2 * 10**9 for result in results)
postconditions.description: Each result is between 0 and 2 * 10^9 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(result == max_possible_score(n, weights) for (n, *weights), result in zip(test_cases, results))
postconditions.description: Each result is the maximum possible final score for the given test case.
